fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Andorra can only be entered by travelling through France or Spain.
entry.es: Solo se puede entrar en Andorra pasando por Francia o España.
entry.quote: You must travel through France or Spain to enter Andorra.

entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que piensa salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: EU citizens may enter Andorra with only an ID card, while other foreigners, including citizens of non-EU Schengen countries, need a passport.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos de la UE pueden entrar en Andorra solo con el documento de identidad; los demás extranjeros, incluidos los de países Schengen no miembros de la UE, necesitan pasaporte.
entry.quote: Citizens of all European Union member states may enter Andorra using only their ID cards, but all other foreigners, including citizens of non-EU Schengen countries, are required to have a passport.

entry.en: Hotels and tourist apartments must register all overnight guests with the police and need their passport details.
entry.es: Los hoteles y apartamentos turísticos deben registrar ante la policía a todos los huéspedes y necesitan los datos de su pasaporte.
entry.quote: Hotels and tourist apartments must register the names of all overnight guests with the police. You must provide your passport details.

entry.en: Adults travelling alone with children should bring a copy of any custody documents or written authorisation from the other parent.
entry.es: Los adultos que viajen solos con niños deben llevar copia de los documentos de custodia o una autorización escrita del otro progenitor.
entry.quote: Single parents or other adults travelling alone with children should bring a copy of any custody documents or written authorisation from the other parent.

entry.en: Andorra is not in the EU, so taxes and duties may apply on tobacco, liquor and luxury goods when re-entering France and Spain.
entry.es: Andorra no pertenece a la UE, por lo que pueden aplicarse impuestos y aranceles al tabaco, licores y artículos de lujo al volver a entrar en Francia y España.
entry.quote: Andorra is not a member of the EU. You may have to pay taxes and duties on tobacco, liquor and luxury goods when you re-enter France and Spain.

safety.en: There is not much threat from other people in Andorra, but visitors should be careful in the mountains.
safety.es: Hay pocas amenazas de otras personas en Andorra, pero hay que tener cuidado en la montaña.
safety.quote: There is not much threat from other people in Andorra, but keep safe on mountains.

safety.en: It is illegal to drink alcohol in the street.
safety.es: Es ilegal beber alcohol en la calle.
safety.quote: It is illegal to drink alcohol in the street.

safety.en: Andorra has a zero-tolerance policy on the possession and use of illegal drugs.
safety.es: Andorra aplica tolerancia cero a la posesión y el consumo de drogas ilegales.
safety.quote: Andorra has a zero-tolerance policy on the possession and use of illegal drugs.

safety.en: Drink-driving laws are stricter than in many countries, with fines of up to 600 euros and a 2-month driving ban.
safety.es: Las leyes sobre conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol son más estrictas que en muchos países, con multas de hasta 600 euros y 2 meses sin conducir.
safety.quote: Andorra has stricter drink-driving laws than many other countries, including the UK. You can get a fine of up to 600 euros and a 2-month driving ban.

safety.en: From 1 November to 15 May, winter tyres or snow chains are required in Andorra.
safety.es: Del 1 de noviembre al 15 de mayo es obligatorio usar neumáticos de invierno o llevar cadenas en Andorra.
safety.quote: From 1 November to 15 May, you must use winter tyres or carry snow chains in Andorra.

safety.en: Visitors should buy their own drinks and keep sight of them so they are not spiked.
safety.es: Conviene comprar las propias bebidas y no perderlas de vista para que no las adulteren.
safety.quote: Buy your own drinks and always keep sight of them to make sure they are not spiked.

health.es: Para pedir una ambulancia, marque el 116.
health.quote: Dial 116 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: The EHIC and GHIC health cards are not valid in Andorra, so comprehensive travel and medical insurance is advised.
health.es: Las tarjetas sanitarias EHIC y GHIC no son válidas en Andorra, por lo que se aconseja un seguro de viaje y médico completo.
health.quote: The European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) and Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) are not valid in Andorra. Take out comprehensive travel and medical insurance before travelling.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Andorra.
health.es: La enfermedad de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de Andorra.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Andorra.

health.en: Tap water is drinkable, though newcomers may find local microbes and minerals upset their stomach at first.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable, aunque a quien llega de lejos los microbios y minerales locales pueden sentarle mal al principio.
health.quote: Tap water is drinkable, though if you're coming from far away it's possible the local microbes and minerals may upset your stomach at first.

health.en: The main hospital in Andorra is the Meritxell Hospital, phone +376 871 000.
health.es: El principal hospital de Andorra es el Hospital Meritxell, teléfono +376 871 000.
health.quote: The main hospital in Andorra is the Meritxell (pronounced merichai) Hospital (+376 871 000).

help.en: Emergency numbers are 116 for an ambulance, 118 for fire, 110 for police and 112 for mountain rescue.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son 116 (ambulancia), 118 (bomberos), 110 (policía) y 112 (rescate de montaña).

getting_in.en: Because of the mountains, there is only one road into Andorra from France and one widely-used road from Spain.
getting_in.es: Por las montañas, solo hay una carretera de entrada desde Francia y una de uso generalizado desde España.
getting_in.quote: Due mainly to the mountainous nature of Andorra, there is only one road entering Andorra from France, and only one widely-used road entering Andorra from Spain.

getting_in.en: Andorra has no airports, and the nearest is La Seu d'Urgell Airport (LEU) in Spain.
getting_in.es: Andorra no tiene aeropuertos; el más cercano es el de La Seu d'Urgell (LEU), en España.
getting_in.quote: There are no airports in Andorra. The nearest airport is 1 La Seu d'Urgell Airport (LEU IATA)

getting_in.en: Toulouse-Blagnac airport (TLS) in France is 196 km to the north.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Toulouse-Blagnac (TLS), en Francia, está a 196 km al norte.
getting_in.quote: Toulouse–Blagnac (TLS IATA) (France) 196 km (122 mi) to the north.

getting_in.en: Barcelona El Prat airport (BCN) in Spain is 202 km to the south.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Barcelona El Prat (BCN), en España, está a 202 km al sur.
getting_in.quote: Barcelona El Prat (BCN IATA) (Spain) 202 km (126 mi) to the south.

getting_in.en: Andorra has never had a railway.
getting_in.quote: Andorra is the only sovereign non-island state in Europe to have never had a railway.

getting_in.en: Six trains per day run from Toulouse-Matabiau to Gare d'Andorre-L'Hospitalet in France, taking 2½ hours and costing €23.40.
getting_in.es: Seis trenes diarios van de Toulouse-Matabiau a la estación de Andorre-L'Hospitalet, en Francia, y tardan 2½ horas por 23,40 €.
getting_in.quote: Six trains per day run from Toulouse-Matabiau (2½ hr, €23.40).

getting_around.en: Most main villages can be visited by the local bus service run by Cooperativa Interurbana Andorrana.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los pueblos principales se pueden visitar con el servicio local de autobuses de la Cooperativa Interurbana Andorrana.
getting_around.quote: you can easily visit most of the main villages by the local bus service operated by Cooperativa Interurbana Andorrana, S.A.

getting_around.en: Bus fares are between €1.85 and €6.10 one-way depending on distance.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de autobús van de 1,85 € a 6,10 € por trayecto según la distancia.
getting_around.quote: The fare is between €1.85 to €6.10 one-way depending on how far you are going.

getting_around.en: A journey planner called Mou-te is available for iOS and Android.
getting_around.es: Existe un planificador de viajes llamado Mou-te para iOS y Android.
getting_around.quote: There is a journey planner called Mou-te (iOS, Android).

getting_around.en: Línea Verde is a free minibus connecting Caldea with Berenador and Camp del Serrat.
getting_around.es: La Línea Verde es un minibús gratuito que conecta Caldea con Berenador y Camp del Serrat.
getting_around.quote: Línea Verde is a free minibus connecting Caldea in Andorra la Vella/Escaldes-Engordany with Berenador (and Camp del Serrat).

getting_around.en: The top speed limit in Andorra is 90 km/h.
getting_around.es: El límite máximo de velocidad en Andorra es de 90 km/h.
getting_around.quote: In Andorra, the top speed restriction is 90 km/h.

getting_around.en: Taxi Barras provides local taxi service at +376 323743.
getting_around.es: Taxi Barras ofrece servicio local de taxi en el +376 323743.

money.quote: Andorra uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Duty-free goods such as perfumes, cigarettes and alcohol are popular purchases in Andorra la Vella, a tax haven.
money.es: Los artículos libres de impuestos, como perfumes, cigarrillos y alcohol, son compras populares en Andorra la Vella, un paraíso fiscal.
money.quote: Andorra la Vella is a tax haven and thus typical duty free shopping goods, such as perfumes, cigarettes and alcohol, are popular purchases.

etiquette.en: People could be offended if you say that Andorra is part of Spain or France.
etiquette.es: La gente podría ofenderse si dice que Andorra forma parte de España o Francia.
etiquette.quote: Andorra is not part of Spain or France, and people could be offended if you say that it is.

connectivity.en: Andorra's telecom providers are outside the EU roaming zone, so roaming charges can be hefty unless your plan includes Andorra.
connectivity.es: Los operadores de Andorra están fuera de la zona de roaming de la UE, por lo que el roaming puede ser caro salvo que su plan incluya Andorra.
connectivity.quote: Andorra's telecom providers are not part of the EU roaming zone so turn off your cell phone if you want to avoid hefty roaming charges, unless your plan allows you to roam in Andorra.

connectivity.en: Andorra Telecom sells SIMs for €15 with €15 credit preloaded.
connectivity.es: Andorra Telecom vende SIM por 15 € con 15 € de saldo precargado.
connectivity.quote: Andorra Telecom sells SIMs for €15 with €15 credit preloaded.

connectivity.en: Free public WiFi is available in parts of major towns, and many restaurants have WiFi too.
connectivity.es: Hay wifi público gratuito en partes de las ciudades principales, y muchos restaurantes también tienen wifi.
connectivity.quote: Free public WiFi is available in parts of major towns, and many restaurants have WiFi as well.
